videos.script: Last course, Ana built a warehouse for the bookshop. Every row in it got there because she typed a command. {{typed}} That works once. It does not work every night for three years. {{nights}} Tonight the tills will sell a hundred and eighty orders. Five old orders will be refunded. Four customers will move city. {{changes}} Somebody has to carry all of that into the warehouse before the managers wake up. And nobody will be watching when it happens. {{nobody}} That somebody is a pipeline. This course is how to write one you can trust. {{pipeline}} In this lesson you build the lab, and you play the shop's first day of March into it. {{lab}} Then you move that day twice. Once as a batch, the whole day at once. Once as a stream, an event at a time, a second behind. {{two}} The difference between them is not speed. It is how old an answer may be when somebody reads it. {{age}}
